name: coredoc-workflows
description: Self-contained engineering workflows with read-only Coredoc context, explicit peer adapters, bundled macOS ARM browser QA, and an opt-in macOS capture agent.

interface.longDescription: Routes work through investigation, planning, adaptive implementation, optional strict TDD, review, spec, browser QA, benchmark, security, learning, and retrospective methods; offers explicit Claude and Codex peer review; grounds decisions with read-only Coredoc context; and includes an optional per-user macOS capture agent.
defaultPrompt: Route this task through the smallest useful workflow.
Review this change against the repository rules.
Turn this idea into an executable specification.
